name: Creotech Quantum S.A.
summary: Creotech Quantum S.A. designs and manufactures electronics and complete technology systems in the European Union and internationally. It offers quantum key distribution (QKD) systems, cameras for astronomy and research laboratories, white rabbit precise time-synchronization systems, and control and measurement systems. The company serves public sector, critical infrastructure, telecommunications, finance, and defense industries. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.
